notes.pages_rechecked: pages whose latest reachable scan falls in the week and that have enough earlier comparable scans to compare against
notes.gained: pages whose latest scan found the item while every earlier comparable scan did not, per group
notes.lost: pages whose latest scan did not find the item while every earlier comparable scan did, per group
notes.earlier_checks: number of earlier comparable scans of the page
notes.links: links found by the latest scan; credential parameters masked
notes.host: page host without a leading www., used to count websites

open_social_platforms.reason: no page has been scanned with social detection version 3 yet; older scans counted TikTok and YouTube links as Mastodon

accessibility_statements.rule: A page gained a statement when its latest reachable scan found an accessibility statement link and at least 2 earlier reachable scans all found none; it lost one when all of those earlier scans found one and the latest does not.
